critical_code_review_comments: OK: ClientDetail uses loans[loans.length-1] for ReLoanModal — shows the most recently created loan as 'existing loan'. This is expected behavior but could be confusing for clients with many loans. Consider showing most recent ACTIVE loan or letting user pick.
OK: Net-off amount is calculated server-side (total_repayable - total_paid), client just sends net_off=true. This is correct and secure.
OK: Re-Loan button appears for CLOSED loans too in LoanDetail (no status check in the button visibility). Requirements say this is correct.

LOW: The vasuli/collection sheet navigation in the regression test script redirected to '/' in the browser session — possible session cookie domain issue in test automation. The collection sheet was verified working in iteration_9 (100% pass) and no code changes affect it.
OK: loan_number generation uses generate_loan_number() function which increments L-counter correctly (TE0002-L1 → TE0002-L2 → TE0002-L3 etc.)
